name: preview
description: View a script's output, post-VAR. A script surfaces records via xi::use("preview").process(pg_id, rec) (see <xi/xi_preview.hpp>: pvar). Keeps the latest record per preview-group; JPEG-encodes images through the host cache and PUSHES them live as XPV1 binary frames (host emit_binary). Pull views: list_groups / get / get_image.
